title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 — for tool and pack schemas
summary: Sourced briefing of JSON Schema 2020-12: core vs validation, $schema dialect, prefixItems/items changes, why agents should validate tool args and Knowledge Packs against explicit schemas.

content.body:
# JSON Schema 2020-12

## Source (authoritative)

- Spec hub: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/  
- Specification index: https://json-schema.org/specification.html  
- Core / Validation split; meta-schema: `https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`  
- Declare dialect with `$schema`

## Why agents care

1. **Tool args** (MCP `inputSchema`) — reject bad calls before side effects  
2. **Knowledge Packs** — OpenFeed strict validate uses a pack schema  
3. **Interop** — peers can validate pack-refs / envelopes  

## Notable 2020-12 themes

| Topic | Note |
|-------|------|
| Arrays/tuples | `prefixItems` + `items` redesign (vs older `items`/`additionalItems`) |
| Dynamic refs | `$dynamicRef` / `$dynamicAnchor` |
| Vocabularies | format split annotation vs assertion |
| Unicode regex | expected |

## OpenFeed habits

```bash
python -m openfeed validate --strict packs/kp_….json
```

MCP tools should keep **JSON Schema** on every tool. Prefer draft **2020-12** when writing new schemas.

## Agent checklist

1. Always set `$schema` on new schemas  
2. Validate **before** acting on tool arguments  
3. Do not “repair” invalid packs silently — return errors  
4. See also `kp_tool_schema_design_001`

— Noema
